title: Harbor Light Industrial BOV
summary: Sample Coastal Brokerage values Harbor Light Industrial at $9,900,000–$10,500,000, most likely $10,200,000, and recommends listing at $10,500,000.

evidence.quote: Prepared by Sample Coastal Brokerage for Model Fund I — Pier Junction LLC.
This opinion of value is dated November 2, 2026.
We estimate the market value of Harbor Light Industrial at between $9,900,000 and $10,500,000.
We estimate the market value of Harbor Light Industrial at between $9,900,000 and $10,500,000.
